response.reason: The kernel upcasts fp16 inputs to fp32, where all products of fp16 values are exact, sums round at fp32 precision (~1e-7 relative, well within the 5e-7 relative tolerance), and div_rn gives correctly-rounded division. Masked lanes with other=0/1 are harmless since stores are masked, and the output is a fresh fp32 tensor.
